narrative.overview:
One lamp, one hard problem, one in the morning. The whole system is built from the objects actually on that desk: graphite, brass, and paper. The page is the unlit room, surfaces are the parts of the desk the lamp reaches, and the accent is the lamp itself. Nothing on screen is there to be admired.

This system is deliberately not derived from its category. Math education does not get to mean primary colors and mascots; a dark developer-adjacent tool does not get to mean terminal green or cyan on black.

Density is the governing virtue. Warmth is real but it is carried entirely by voice, attribution, and visible seams, never by softer shapes, brighter color, illustration, or celebration.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-primary, warm-neutral. Never blue-black, never pure black.
One accent (brass), on 10% of any screen or less.
Flat by construction. Depth comes from four tonal floors, never from shadow.
Type hierarchy that descends monotonically, in both size and contrast.
A real monospace for math, code, and identifiers.
Motion that reports state in 150 to 220ms, or does not happen.

rules.name: The One Lamp Rule
rules.body: Brass appears on at most 10% of any screen. It marks what is interactive, what is selected, and what has focus. Its rarity is the entire mechanism by which it works.

rules.name: The No Pure Ends Rule
rules.body: #000 and #fff are prohibited, in every file, with no exception. If a value has three equal channels, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Two Signals Rule
rules.body: Sage and Clay are the complete status vocabulary. No info blue, no warning yellow, no separate danger red.

rules.name: The Never Color Alone Rule
rules.body: Difficulty, progress, contest status, and correctness must each carry a label, icon, or position in addition to hue.

rules.name: The Descending Rule
rules.body: Heading rank falls monotonically in both size and contrast. A page title is never smaller than a heading inside its own content.

rules.name: The Measure Rule
rules.body: Prose is capped at 68ch and the cap is opt-out, not opt-in. The measure must not change partway down a page.

rules.name: The Real Monospace Rule
rules.body: font-mono must resolve to an actual monospaced family. Aliasing the mono slot to the body sans is prohibited.

rules.name: The Four Floors Rule
rules.body: A surface may sit at most one tonal floor above its parent. A card inside a card inside a card is always wrong.

rules.name: The No Glass Rule
rules.body: backdrop-filter and blur() are prohibited as surface treatments. Panels are opaque.

dos: Do cap prose at 68ch, and make wide content escape the measure explicitly.
Do keep Lamp Brass under 10% of any screen.
Do express depth with the four tonal floors and 1px hairlines.
Do give every interactive element all seven states: default, hover, focus, active, disabled, loading, error.
Do render focus as a 2px Lamp Brass outline at 2px offset.
Do pair every status color with a label, icon, or position.
Do guard all animation with prefers-reduced-motion and keep transitions 150 to 220ms.
Do resolve font-mono to IBM Plex Mono for LaTeX, code, keys, problem IDs, and numeric columns.
Do name the author and expose edit-on-GitHub inline on content pages.
donts: Don't use border-left or border-right above 1px as a colored accent on any blockquote, callout, card, or list item.
Don't use backdrop-filter, blur(), or translucent panels as a surface treatment.
Don't ship #000 or #fff, or any untinted grey.
Don't build identical rounded card grids, hero-metric templates, or gradient accents.
Don't reach for bright primaries, mascots, illustrated empty states, or badge-and-confetti gamification.
Don't reproduce dense forum-era chrome, cramped tables, or nested bordered boxes.
Don't drift toward the academic-manuscript lane as an escape from the above.
Don't animate layout properties. Animate transform, opacity, and color only.
Don't use translateY hover lifts on cards or buttons.
Don't remove a focus outline without an equally visible replacement.
Don't introduce a third font family.
Don't open with a modal where an inline affordance exists on the same page.
Don't alias stock Tailwind class names to different colors.
